components.name: Solar Cells (Monocrystalline Silicon)
components.reasoning: These are the core photovoltaic conversion elements responsible for converting sunlight into electricity; they are always procured as separate cell wafers or assembled cell strings.

components.name: Tempered Glass Cover
components.reasoning: This is the front protective layer that shields the solar cells from environmental damage while allowing light transmission; it is a standardized component supplied independently from module manufacturers.

components.name: Aluminum Frame
components.reasoning: A structural support that provides rigidity and mounting capability for the panel; frames are typically manufactured or procured separately from solar cell assemblies.

components.name: Junction Box
components.reasoning: Houses electrical connections and bypass diodes to ensure safe and efficient electrical operation; junction boxes are distinct components sourced from specialized suppliers.

components.name: Encapsulation Material (EVA)
components.reasoning: Encapsulant layers secure and protect the cells inside the module; ethylene-vinyl acetate sheets are industry standard encapsulants, typically procured as a separate material rolled or pre-cut.

components.name: Backsheet
components.reasoning: Provides electrical insulation and moisture barrier on the rear side of the module; backsheets are specialized polymer laminates procured as finished sheets with their own supply chain.

Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.name: Silicon
Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.reasoning: Primary semiconductor material essential for photovoltaic energy conversion; absolutely essential and industry standard for monocrystalline solar cells.

Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.name: Silver
Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.reasoning: Used for front contact metallization to collect current; widely used in industry with some emerging copper alternatives.

Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.name: Aluminum
Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.reasoning: Used for back contact and frame, providing structural support and electrical conduction; standard material for solar cells.

Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.name: Phosphorus
Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.reasoning: N-type dopant creating the PN junction essential for cell function; standard though arsenic can be alternative.

Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.name: Boron
Monocrystalline Silicon Solar Cells.reasoning: P-type dopant used in silicon cells to form the PN junction with phosphorus; standard doping element with some gallium alternatives.

Glass Cover.name: Glass
Glass Cover.reasoning: Primary structural and protective material providing optical transparency and durability, universally used for solar panel covers.

Glass Cover.name: Borosilicate glass
Glass Cover.reasoning: Commonly used variant of glass with increased thermal resistance and durability in outdoor environments; standard but some panels use regular glass.

Junction Box.name: Polypropylene
Junction Box.reasoning: Common polymer for junction box housing due to chemical resistance and durability; widely used but alternatives like polycarbonate exist.

Junction Box.name: Copper
Junction Box.reasoning: Critical conductor for internal wiring and electrical connection in junction box; industry standard.

Junction Box.name: Polyethylene
Junction Box.reasoning: Used in some electrical insulating parts and protective components; alternatives exist so moderately confident.

Chassis Assembly.name: Aluminum
Chassis Assembly.reasoning: Primary material for solar panel frames due to light weight, corrosion resistance, and structural strength; industry standard.

Chassis Assembly.name: Stainless steel
Chassis Assembly.reasoning: Sometimes used as structural reinforcement or fasteners; alternatives exist but common in higher-end frames.

Eva Encapsulation Material.name: Ethylene glycol
Eva Encapsulation Material.reasoning: Used as a precursor or plasticizer in polymer encapsulants like EVA; moderately confident since EVA is polyethylene-based and ethylene glycol is a base compound.

Eva Encapsulation Material.name: Polyethylene
Eva Encapsulation Material.reasoning: Base polymer backbone related to EVA encapsulation films; commonly used polymer family though EVA is a specific copolymer.

High-conductivity Cable.name: Copper
High-conductivity Cable.reasoning: Primary conductor material for electrical cables due to excellent conductivity; absolutely essential and industry standard.

High-conductivity Cable.name: Polyvinyl chloride
High-conductivity Cable.reasoning: Common insulating and jacketing polymer for cables; alternatives include polyethylene but PVC is widely used.

Mounting Rail System.name: Aluminum
Mounting Rail System.reasoning: Primary structural metal for mounting rails due to light weight, corrosion resistance, and strength; industry standard.

Mounting Rail System.name: Steel Ingots
Mounting Rail System.reasoning: Used in some structural components or fasteners within mounting systems; alternatives exist so moderate confidence.

Cable And Connectors Assembly.name: Copper
Cable And Connectors Assembly.reasoning: Critical conductor material in connectors and cables; universal standard for electrical conductivity.

Cable And Connectors Assembly.name: Polyvinyl chloride
Cable And Connectors Assembly.reasoning: Common polymer used for insulation and sheathing on cables and connectors; alternative polymers exist but widely used.
